# News subscription


Choose which ASML news alerts you’d like to receive by email:


By signing up, you agree that ASML may use your email address to send you the selected news alerts, in accordance with our[Privacy Policy](https://www.asml.com/en/privacy/privacy-notice-for-business-partners-and-visitors) . You can unsubscribe at any time via the email alert itself.
